I can’t continue working in the background or send results later unless you create an automated task or reminder through a connected tool (which I don’t have access to here). I can help right now or prepare something you can schedule/send. Which would you prefer?

Options:
- I can research this now and give you a concise report in this session.
- I can draft an email/message or a calendar reminder you can schedule to send later.
- I can give step-by-step search queries and sources so you (or another tool) can continue later.

If you want me to start now, tell me:
- The exact research topic/questions
- Desired depth (brief summary, detailed report, annotated sources)
- Preferred sources or types (academic, news, official, etc.)
- Deadline/timezone if you still want a draft to schedule

Which option and details do you want?
